60: With the help of God, from Rosh Hashanah.

'Inscribe us for life.' For in every Jewish person there is a holy point in his heart, and it is the soul of life, as it is said, 'And eternal life You planted within us.' But throughout the year, as sins accumulate, as the material gains strength and covers the aforementioned point, a person needs to ask mercy from the Holy One, blessed be He, to renew this impression in his heart on Rosh Hashanah. And for this we ask, 'Inscribe us for life.' And this is what is said, 'Engraved on the tablets,' which our Sages interpreted as freedom from the angel of death and the evil inclination. Because in receiving the Torah, the Children of Israel were prepared that the writing would never be erased, only through sin was it damaged afterward, and one needs to renew life every year. And the sealing is for this point to be sealed so that vitality does not spread everywhere, as it is said, 'A garden locked, etc., a fountain sealed.'

In the Gemara, the ministering angels said before the Holy One, blessed be He, 'Why don't the Children of Israel say song before You on Rosh Hashanah, etc.', see there. It appears that a person should be prepared to say Hallel on Rosh Hashanah, for it is among the festivals, only that it is hidden, as it is said, 'At the time appointed for our festival day,' and as it is said elsewhere. And therefore the ministering angels said, etc. But the Children of Israel retreat from this understanding because the books of life and death are open, etc. And this is the aspect of 'running and returning,' that the Children of Israel have this level above the ministering angels. And it is as it is said, 'In the place where penitents stand, etc.' And likewise also at the splitting of the Red Sea, 'And one did not come near the other,' our Sages interpreted that they wanted to say song, and the Holy One, blessed be He, said, 'My handiwork is drowning in the sea, etc.' And likewise on Rosh Hashanah, although the Children of Israel need to say song, nevertheless, [they do not say it] since it is in the way of judgment, and the festival is in concealment, and Hallel is the aspect of revealing joy, as explained above.

At the time when the Children of Israel blow the shofar, the Holy One, blessed be He, stands up from the throne of judgment and sits on the throne of mercy. And the main intention should be so that the King sits on the throne of mercy. For it is not good that human beings cause the King to be in the attribute of judgment through them. Therefore, we ask with our blasts that the King be in the attribute of mercy, and when they do this truly, the Holy One, blessed be He, is filled with mercy toward us.

In the Midrash, 'And you, do not fear, My servant Jacob,' that the Holy One, blessed be He, showed the ladder to Jacob our father, and he did not ask to ascend, etc., did not believe and did not ascend, etc. For certainly the aspect of Jacob is above the conduct of nature, which is the matter of the ladder and the level of the four kingdoms and the seventy nations. For it was the desire of our father Jacob to be rectified without sin, as it was at the giving of the Torah, freedom, etc. And they would not have needed the aforementioned levels. But now in exile, we exist by the merit of Abraham and Isaac, as it is said, 'And the binding of Isaac for his seed You shall remember.' And in the Gemara, 'For You are our father' refers to Isaac, etc. Because through the binding, the level of the ladder and the conduct of the world according to judgment and nature was extended, for the world was created with judgment, this conduct was also extended to Israel. And as it is said elsewhere, the interpretation of the verse, 'And your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies,' is the promise that all the entrances and gates that all the nations have, all come through the Children of Israel, who are first even in these gates, as explained above. And this is what is said, 'And you did not withhold your son, etc.' Because Isaac is the aspect of darkness and judgment, and through the binding, this too was extended to the Children of Israel. And from this comes the ability to transform the attribute of judgment to mercy, for the Holy One, blessed be He, to stand up from the throne of judgment and sit on the throne of mercy.
